The team oversees the collection, mapping and maintenance of client, vendor and proprietary company, contact, fund, ownership, and relationship data. Team is also responsible for collecting and maintaining data which provides insight into who is holding, and investing in publicly traded securities, across the world. The data is collected from various regulatory filings, vendors, notifications or press releases and transform the raw information into usable intelligence that can give the clients a competitive edge. Ideate/innovate and provide solutions for new collection methods and product/process enhancements.

MBA with specialization in finance from a reputed institute.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Strong listening and presentation abilities. Capability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time efficiently.

Comfortable to work in night shift, rotational shifts, and flexible hours.

Proficient numerical skills to comprehend financial data for collection and processing.

Knowledge of capital markets including equities and fixed income markets preferred.

Maintain documentation of data sources, update cycles, and report definitions.
Support leadership with decision-making through reliable reporting.

Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas, lookups).
Experience with Looker Studio or or any equivalent visualizations tool(mandatory).
Experience with analytics databases (BigQuery, MySQL, etc.).
Ability to work with raw data and convert it into structured datasets.
Good understanding of dashboards, KPIs, and data visualization principles.
Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.
Comfortable coordinating across teams to collect data regularly.
